name: Testim
description_en:
Testim creates and executes UI tests through local browser, mobile and remote-grid workflows. Its public product site remains testim.io, while the former help root redirects to Tricentis’s Testim documentation. The operating guides describe different execution entry points and a subscription model based on parallelism, not simply a count of saved tests.

Evaluation needs the run’s actual launch path, grid and device configuration. Two runs described as local can have different quota treatment, and a generic localhost address is not the documented local-driver exemption. Pricing and trial eligibility remain independently unverified where current pages disagree.
description_zh:
Testim 通过本地浏览器、移动端及远端 grid 流程创建和执行 UI 测试。产品站仍为 testim.io，旧帮助根站跳到 Tricentis 的 Testim 文档。操作指南区分执行入口，并描述按并行能力的订阅模型，而非仅按保存测试数量。

评估需核对运行真实入口、grid 及设备配置。两个都称“本地”的运行可能有不同配额处理，localhost 地址也不等于文档的本地驱动豁免。当前页面存在差异，价格和试用资格仍独立未核实。

core_features.explanation_en: Run through the editor, local browser, configured grid or CLI with different routing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过编辑器、本地浏览器、已配置 grid 或 CLI 运行，路由不同。

core_features.explanation_en: The Plans guide distinguishes parallel slots and usage-hour conditions.
core_features.explanation_zh: Plans 指南区分并行 slot 及用时条件。

core_features.explanation_en: The account guide describes installing the Testim extension before authoring access.
core_features.explanation_zh: 账户指南说明安装 Testim 扩展及登录设置。

en: Compare one editor-local run with the intended CI/grid entry point.
Pin a mobile target and verify actual parallel-slot/hour accounting with the account owner.
zh: 比较一次编辑器本地运行与目标 CI／grid 入口。
固定移动目标，并同账户负责人核对真实并行 slot／小时核算。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Choose an account/plan and the correct extension or CLI execution mode.
steps.zh: 选择账户／方案及正确扩展或 CLI 执行模式。

steps.en: Pin the environment/device, review quota conditions and inspect failure evidence before scheduling.
steps.zh: 计划前固定环境／设备，核对配额条件并检查失败证据。

items.en: A grid or CLI run against localhost can still consume parallel quota.
items.zh: 指向 localhost 的 grid／CLI 运行仍可能消耗并行配额。

items.en: Omitted remote mobile configuration can select the first available device.
items.zh: 省略远端移动配置可能选择第一台可用设备。

pricing.summary_en: The current commercial offer is unresolved: account onboarding retains1,000-free-runs/7-day-trial wording while Plans describes parallel slots and usage hours. No universal numeric rate or current account eligibility was verified. Pricing remains not_verified/unknown; documented quota mechanics are not a purchase or free-use approval.
pricing.summary_zh: 当前商业方案未解决：入门保留一千免费 runs／七天试用措辞，Plans 则描述并行 slot 和用时。未确认统一数字价格或当前账户资格，价格保持 not_verified／unknown；配额机制不构成购买或免费使用批准。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Proposed examples were not executed.

sections.title_en: Confirm where the test will actually run
sections.title_zh: 确认测试真实运行位置
sections.en: The overview separates local/editor and grid runs. Web Test List runs are local; Scheduler runs use a remote grid and require a label or suite. Record the actual launch path/environment before comparing a manual pass with CI.
sections.zh: 概览区分本地／编辑器与 grid。Web Test List 在本地运行，Scheduler 用远端 grid 且需 label 或 suite。比较手动通过与 CI 前，应记录真实入口／环境。

sections.title_zh: 使移动设备选择可复现
sections.en: Remote mobile runs need a grid and configuration. Without configuration, the first available grid device is used; editor overrides can change the device/app. Pin the target and inspect result metadata before comparing a rerun with the original failure.
sections.zh: 远端移动运行需 grid 和配置；缺配置时用 grid 第一台可用设备，编辑器覆盖可改变设备／应用。比较重跑与原始失败前，应固定目标并检查结果元数据。

sections.title_en: Localhost is not the local-driver exemption
sections.title_zh: Localhost 不等于本地驱动豁免
sections.en: Plans uses parallelization rather than runs. Editor-local and use-local-chrome-driver runs are exempt; CLI/grid localhost runs still count. It lists 1,000 monthly hours across three parallels and200 per additional parallel. Confirm the actual account terms; local execution does not universally mean free use.
sections.zh: Plans 按并行而非 runs。本地编辑器及 use-local-chrome-driver 豁免，CLI／grid 的 localhost 仍计。页面列三并行共每月一千小时、额外并行各二百小时。需核对账户条款，本地不普遍等于免费。

sections.title_en: Reconcile account onboarding with the selected plan
sections.title_zh: 将账户入门与所选方案对应
sections.en: The account guide describes extension installation and account signup but retains wording about1,000 free monthly runs and a 7-day trial enabled through contact. That is not automatically compatible with the newer parallelism model. Confirm account eligibility and actual plan before assigning a free allowance. No signup, browser extension or credentials were used here.
sections.zh: 账户指南描述扩展安装与注册，但保留每月一千免费 runs 及联系启用七天试用的措辞，未必与较新并行模型对应。赋予免费额度前应核对账户资格及真实方案；本次未注册、安装扩展或使用凭据。

sections.title_en: Review the generated CLI target and credential
sections.title_zh: 检查生成的 CLI 目标及凭据
sections.en: The CLI generator includes token/project plus a grid or local-driver mode. Review the generated target and keep credentials in the established CI secret mechanism. No command was executed; retention, isolation and retry billing remain unverified.
sections.zh: CLI 生成器包含 token／project 与 grid 或本地驱动模式。应检查生成目标，沿用既有 CI secret 机制；本次未执行命令，保留、隔离及重试费用待核。
